fnol_text: My name is Marcus Okafor and I live at 932 Hawthorn Road, Madison, WI 53782. You can reach me on (555) 358-4849 or marcus.okafor@example.com. After the burst pipe last month was fixed, on 5 February 2025 we found black mould inside the wall cavity behind the kitchen units. Policy HH-2023-00073. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Okafor on (555) 358-4849 to acknowledge the claim. Marcus confirmed the loss date as 5 February 2025.
Site visit to 932 Hawthorn Road. Neighbour Lucia Takahashi was present and confirmed the timeline.
